title: ImpactBridge — Acceptance Test Pack Report v3 (post-remediation)
baseline: Report v2 (25 Oct 2026, deployment impactbridge-omega.vercel.app): 91 cases — 20 PASS, 28 PARTIAL, 22 FAIL, 7 NOT BUILT, 14 NOT RUN.
method: Each of the 91 sheet cases has a Playwright test of the same ID that drives the real UI in Chromium against the application running on a seeded PostgreSQL database (synthetic data only, sandbox/manual-test payments, no real money). Unit and integration tests run with Vitest. Same pass rule as v2: a case passes only when the visible expected result works with persisted data.

defects.title: Stale OPEN RiskReview blocked verification
defects.cause: Triage returned early on a SAFE verdict, so the risk review raised against the NGO's earlier, wrong documents was never superseded; verification read only the newest open review; no API listed reviews. Registration also loaded the document-analysis runner with require(), which returned no export, so re-analysis never started.
defects.fix: A clean re-analysis now closes the triage review it opened and resolves its alerts (never admin- or agent-raised reviews); verification weighs all open reviews; GET /api/admin/risk/review lists them; analysis starts via dynamic import; NGOs get “Replace your documents” with a prefilled form.

defects.title: Field-evidence photo sync returned 500
defects.cause: Private uploads ignored STORAGE_PROVIDER=cloudinary and wrote to the read-only serverless filesystem (EROFS); the route hid the cause behind a generic 500.
defects.fix: Cloudinary authenticated private storage; structured error codes (413/415/503/409); client-id idempotency; signed, expiring, per-viewer photo links that re-check access on every fetch.

defects.title: RFP upload / extraction returned an empty 500
defects.cause: Document-parser modules failed to load on serverless before the handler ran; model/storage failures surfaced as bare 500s; the Claude schema exceeded the API's union-type limit.
defects.fix: Lazy parser loading; JSON errors with codes and a retryable FAILED state; Claude → Gemini → rule-based extraction with per-field confidence; manual entry; union-free Claude schema.

defects.title: Milestones stayed UNFUNDED after full reconciliation
defects.cause: Payments were recorded with no milestone link and nothing allocated reconciled money to milestones; allocation existed only for the legacy Proposal model.
defects.fix: Reconciled money is allocated to milestones in delivery order (or the milestone the donor chose) inside a row-locked transaction; milestone funding status, admin allocation approval, contract and project FUNDED.

defects.title: UTR-based reconciliation not possible
defects.cause: Sandbox mode discarded the supplied UTR; the reconciliation sweep did no UTR matching.
defects.fix: UTR stored and normalised in every mode, duplicates refused per payer account; reconciliation matches bank-statement lines by UTR and amount; unmatched lines go to an exception queue with manual match.

built: NGO team invites for Program Manager and Field Worker (hashed, expiring, single-use tokens; revoke/resend; field workers see only their tasks).
Admin Finance, Auditor (read-only) and Support roles with distinct permissions; donor-team Finance role.
Break-glass support access: reasoned, time-boxed (≤ 60 min), audited, revocable grants.
Tamper-evident audit log: database-enforced append-only hash chain, live verifier and export verifier.
Operator dead-letter queue with one-time replay for failed jobs.
NGO registration save-and-resume drafts; NGO expense/utilisation recording per contract milestone.
Stored impact reports, donor re-engagement (renewal / next opportunity), consent-filtered impact stories.
Admin-triggered re-verification (review-due) workflow; structured FCRA-required field; admin shortlist approval.
AI call telemetry and admin fault injection; notification channel preferences with fallback and delivery log.

cases.evidence: Admin console loads for admin; an NGO user opening /admin/dashboard is redirected to /unauthorized.

Fresh NGO whose certificate names another organisation → shown AT RISK, approval refused in UI and API → NGO clicks “Replace your documents” (form prefilled) → re-analysis DOCUMENTS CLEAN → admin approves → NGO verified (defect D1 fixed).
Fresh CSR donor; admin Verify Organisation + Verify PAN; donor then passes the funder gate.
Admin “Request re-verification” → NGO dashboard shows the re-verification banner with reason and due date → admin re-decides → banner clears.
Requirement with structured FCRA-required flag excludes FCRA-ineligible NGOs; “see why” shows the rule explanation.
Invite refused before admin review; admin excludes one candidate, reorders and approves the shortlist; ranks persist; excluded NGO cannot be invited.
Creating a contract linked to a requirement before proposal selection is refused (400).
Donor records a payment in the UI, NGO confirms; committed vs reconciled shown separately; receivable schedule per milestone.
NGO uploads a bank statement with a mistyped UTR → admin runs reconciliation → “Bank transfer (UTR) not matched” exception → Match to payment → contract funded (defect D5 fixed).
Same idempotency key replayed → 200 replayed, no second payment row; unsigned webhook rejected (400/503).
Admin approves milestone allocation lines in /admin/allocations; a second decision returns 409; milestones FUNDED (defect D4 fixed).
Admin evidence queue lists field photos; signed photo renders; admin approves (defect D2 fixed).
Duplicate and GPS-mismatch photos are flagged; approving over a flag requires a note; Return to NGO works.
Baseline 42% and endline 61% claims approved in /admin/impact-review; NGO report shows +19 pp.
Consent-filtered funder story generated → admin publishes → visible to the funder.
Grievance Triage → Start investigating → Resolve with outcome note.
Live audit hash chain verifies OK; exported CSV uploaded back verifies OK; tampered export detected (see NEG-013).
Failed job lands in the dead-letter queue → “Replay once” runs the real job → REPLAYED; a second replay returns 409.
Another NGO receives 403/404 on Akshar’s contract, payments, project update, photo and tasks.
Support admin blocked (BREAK_GLASS_REQUIRED) → opens a reasoned, time-boxed grant → access → revoke → 403 again.
Role gates enforced across admin/NGO/donor, including read-only Auditor and Finance admin sub-roles.
Cross-organisation isolation enforced centrally; another NGO cannot read or modify org-owned records.
Beneficiary consent withdrawal hides the photo from the funder and invalidates previously issued links.
Prompt-injection text inside an uploaded RFP is flagged; submission blocked (409 FLAGS_UNCONFIRMED) until a human confirms; eligibility rules unaffected.
Replayed payment request is idempotent — no duplicate record.
Over-payment beyond the unpaid balance refused (422); allocation-level over-allocation refused.
Contract side door before proposal approval refused server-side.
Re-used image flagged as duplicate in the evidence queue.
Photo with GPS far from the project site flagged as GPS mismatch.
Where evidence is missing the impact view shows INSUFFICIENT_DATA — no invented figures.
Donor WhatsApp opt-out honoured; notification falls back to email/in-app and each attempt is logged.
Dead-letter item replays exactly once; second replay refused.
Tampered audit export is detected (HASH_MISMATCH at the edited row).
Donor-facing pages and APIs never expose admin notes, risk scores or AI scores.
Signed photo links are per-viewer and expiring; a tampered link is rejected; revoked link returns 404.
RFP PDF upload extracted by Claude with values and per-field confidence (defect D3 fixed).
RFP with two conflicting budget figures raises a blocking “Conflicting budget figures” flag for human confirmation.
Ranking is explainable: score, coverage and per-dimension reasons shown.
FCRA hard rule overrides any similarity score; exclusion reason visible.
Proposal-assist draft generated for an invited NGO; budget and milestone amounts left empty for the NGO to fill.
AI flags evidence, a human decides; overriding a flag is recorded with the flag codes.
Impact story generated from the UI from approved data.
Public story excludes funder-only and non-consented beneficiary material.
Every AI call is recorded with provider, model, latency and outcome on /admin/ai-telemetry.
Admin fault injection forces an AI timeout; the UI shows “AI unavailable — human review required” instead of an error or invented output.
